names.ice_cream_works_1605_indiana: 1605–1613 Indiana Avenue — the Thompson-Reid and Collins Bros. ice-cream works, building

source.citation: 'Two ice cream concerns to erect plant jointly. Collins Bros. and Thompson-Reid companies buy land and will construct a $40,000 establishment.' Chicago Daily Tribune, 4 September 1903.
what_it_supplies: the sale of 1605-1613 Indiana for the ice-cream plant, September 1903
that the corner, 1601-1603, was not in the sale
